sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 227 (Village of Jacksonville charter): section 3(a), as amended by 2005 No. M-15: five trustees are elected at the annual meeting and serve until their successors are elected; section 3(b) the trustees elect one of themselves President, so no president post is created

Village of Jacksonville (official site of the Jacksonville Electric Company, the village's municipal utility), 'Board of Trustees' page: the page styles the body 'The Village of Jacksonville's Board of Trustee[s]' and lists the current trustees as Kenneth Bernard (term to 2027), Laura Allen, Interim (2028), John Doty, Treasurer (2029), Jenepher Burnell, President (2030), and Tyler Colford, Clerk (2031); the parenthetical roles are board offices, not separate posts. Allen is styled 'Interim'; the charter fills vacancies only at special meetings called for that purpose (section 3(a)), so she is recorded as a seated trustee with the styling disclosed

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 227 (Village of Jacksonville charter): section 3(a): a clerk is elected at the annual meeting; no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership. The electric board's 'Clerk' annotation is a board role and is not shown to be this office

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 227 (Village of Jacksonville charter): section 3(a): a treasurer is elected at the annual meeting; no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership. The electric board's 'Treasurer' annotation is a board role and is not shown to be this office

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 227 (Village of Jacksonville charter): section 3(a): a collector is elected at the annual meeting; no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
